name: blockbench-mcp
description: Create, texture, animate, validate, and render Blockbench models through the desktop MCP connection or the headless .bbmodel server, with fifteen skills for modeling, textures, PBR, particles, animation, and Hytale.

interface.shortDescription: Model, texture, and animate in Blockbench.
interface.longDescription: Use fifteen skills for modeling, texturing, vanilla and AI-generated textures, PBR maps, particles, animation, Hytale, headless .bbmodel workflows, and new-model-to-Blender delivery. The desktop connection needs the Blockbench MCP plugin running on this computer at http://localhost:3000/bb-mcp. The headless server edits, validates, and renders .bbmodel files without Blockbench, starts through npx (Node only), and lets several agents work in parallel.
defaultPrompt: Create a textured low-poly prop in Blockbench.
Animate my Blockbench character with a walk cycle.
Build and validate a .bbmodel file without opening Blockbench.
